title: It's about people. <1>It's about you.</1>
lead: A commitment to our network of service technicians.
p1: 50 years walking into people's homes and solving real problems.
p2: The network isn't logos or processes: it's you.
items: — Those of you who get up early.

tagline: Grupo WG works thanks to you.
